sloka: स तूर्णतरमादाय वरहेमाङ्गदो गदाम् ।अभिदुद्राव रक्षांसि तमांसीव दिवाकरः ।। ७.३२.४० ॥
transliteration: sa tūrṇataramādāya varahemāṅgado gadām ।abhidudrāva rakṣāṁsi tamāṁsīva divākaraḥ ।। 7.32.40 ॥

translations.english: Adorned with splendid golden armlets, he swiftly seized his mace and charged at the Rākṣasas, just as the sun dispels darkness.
